evaluation_notes: Upwork jobs include client payment verification status — treat unverified payment as a red flag.
The 'proposals' count indicates competition level — fewer proposals on AR/VR or Rust roles is a positive signal.
Budget can be fixed-price or hourly. Flag budgets below €10/hour or suspiciously low fixed prices for the scope.
Client rating is on a 1–5 scale (5 is the maximum). A rating of 4.5–5/5 is a green flag; below 4/5 or absent is a yellow/red flag.
Client location matters for timezone overlap — prefer EU/US clients for Danylo in Berlin.
Upwork-specific red flags: spec work, test tasks without pay, vague 'we'll discuss' budgets, milestone-heavy low-trust setups.
